about: Tekken 2 Content's Stages, Performance (tools/t2_performance_stages.py): what each Remake pack leaves out, by Tekken 2's stage number. The user's, 2026-11-21 (issue #13): objects off drops the stage's moving objects (T2OB, T2RT, T2OA and their machine's section); drop leaves sections out; counts lowers the count at a section's start (FTHR, FFLY, RAIN: the first int16); layouts keeps the first n of T2OB's drawing calls (the birds before the critters and the grass: the critters' and the grass's go, their machine stays); scenery: the stage built again by the Remake's generator without these pieces of its scenery (by the builder's name in t2_remake_stage.scenery(): drop leaves them all out, keep {name: [the calls kept, from 0]}, every {name: n} keeps every n-th call, or tuft, faces {name: [pictures]} its faces of these pictures), only its tiles (TILE, T2TL) and the Church's walls (COLL) taken.
